purpose: Device-owned typed HTLC GPU witness/public generation and complete single-AIR proving with the existing typed verifier and encoding
result: Sixteen GPU-required release HTLC proofs and eight debug-compatible HTLC proofs CPU-verified after GPU shutdown; release requests complete all 15 applicable arithmetic stages

htlc.conformance: Every CPU/GPU trace cell and public value compared for plain, redeem, refund, range boundaries, raw field-key boundaries and two redeemed inputs
htlc.admission_controls: CPU-required, debug GPU-required, wrong profile, mint and public-worker assignment rejected before private allocation/upload
htlc.acceptance_boundary: SHA-256 preimage acceptance and independently expected block height remain external host checks; input note type/mode are boolean, while output note type retains the existing AIR semantics

pilot_notes: The first Rust build found a test-only local Run binding shadowing the run helper; the failed log is preserved. Scoping that staging check fixed the build.
All three pilot-02 runtime checks passed without changing the HTLC kernels.
limitations: OpenCL RTX 5080 Laptop correctness qualification, not production throughput calibration
Debug uses an explicit CPU constraint audit and rejects GPU-required admission
Legacy quadratic wallet/batch integration, private wallet worker transport/admission, owned multi-AIR commitments and full-size recursive qualification remain open
AMD and Metal are unqualified; pending Apple source requires its local Mac checkpoint commit
Host metadata, entropy acquisition, orchestration, serialization, independent verification and external preimage acceptance remain outside proving arithmetic
